data.name: Azeria
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Azeria is the goddess of the Azores, a group of volcanic islands in the mid-Atlantic Ocean. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'azara', meaning 'dry' or 'parched'. Azeria was believed to protect sailors and fishermen, ensuring safe travel and abundant catches.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of protection and prosperity for those at sea.
data.cultural_impact: The name "Azeria" carries a rich cultural heritage, connecting it to Greek mythology and the ancient belief in the protection of sailors and fishermen. This name can serve as a reminder of our ancestral maritime traditions and the vital role that the sea plays in our history and daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Azeria" represents the patronage of a goddess who ensures safety, abundance, and protection for those who navigate the vast expanse of the sea. On a personal level, it can serve as a reminder of the divine presence that guides us through our lives, providing us with strength, courage, and blessings in times of uncertainty or hardship.
